sovereign_country.strategic_role: 制造业产业链转移第一站、保税加工（EPE）设立首选

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Legal Accounting Defense for International Anti-Dumping Inquiries

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law system influenced by socialist legality, commercial statutes, and international trade law; not a pure common law or Islamic Sharia jurisdiction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement on Investment under the ASEAN–Australia–New Zealand Free Trade Area (AANZFTA)
Bilateral Investment Treaty between Viet Nam and the Netherlands
Bilateral Investment Treaty between Viet Nam and the Republic of Korea
Bilateral Investment Treaty between Viet Nam and Japan
Bilateral Investment Treaty between Viet Nam and the United Kingdom (carryover)
Viet Nam – European Union Investment Protection Agreement (EVIPA, pending ratification but recognized)
Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP)
Viet Nam – United States Trade and Investment Framework Agreement (TIFA, non-BIT framework)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Prevention and Combating Money Laundering No. 02/2025/QH15 (effective 1 July 2025); Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 32–36 on enterprise registration and legal representative duties); Law on Anti-Corruption No. 36/2005/QH11 as amended; Government Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration and Decree No. 02/2019/ND-CP as amended on the business registration system; State Bank of Viet Nam Circular No. 35/2024/TT-NHNN on anti-money laundering measures; Prime Minister’s Decision No. 29/2023/QD-TTg on the national AML action plan; Viet Nam’s UBO disclosure regime under Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP requiring submission of legal representative and corporate ownership information in the National Enterprise Registration Database; FATF membership obligations (Viet Nam became an FATF member in 2023).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation or Equivalent Business Registration Certificate of the Ultimate Parent Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or equivalent authority in the entity’s country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if originating from a Hague Convention member state) OR Consular Legalization by the Embassy/Consulate of Viet Nam if the origin state is not party to the Hague Apostille Convention; also subject to certified Vietnamese translation and notarization by a Vietnamese notary public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Constitutional Documents (Charter/Memorandum and Articles of Association) of the Ultimate Parent Entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate body of the foreign entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization with official Vietnamese translation and notarization; review period 30–90 days

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of UBO / Register of Directors and Members or Equivalent Ownership Statement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry or corporate secretary of the foreign entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization with recognized translation; must be current as of no more than 60 days before filing

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Identification Documents (Passport/National ID) of the Ultimate Beneficial Owner and Legal Representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport or identity authority of the individual’s country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy in origin country or consular certified; for Vietnamese nationals: notarized copies issued under Decree No. 23/2015/ND-CP; for foreign nationals: consular legalization or apostille plus Vietnamese notarized translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney to the Vietnam-based Incorporation Agent/Licensed Law Firm
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Ultimate parent entity or proposed legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization; must be notarized and translated into Vietnamese; validity limited to 1 year unless expressly extended

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Good Standing Certificate / Certificate of No Bankruptcy for the Foreign Ultimate Parent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry in the foreign parent’s home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille OR Consular Legalization with notarized Vietnamese translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Anti-Dumping Trade Defense Services License / Professional Capacity Evidence of Proposed General Director or Compliant Expert
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vietnamese Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT) Trade Remedies Authority of Viet Nam and/or relevant foreign bar/licensing authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Document issued by competent authority; where foreign, apostille or consular legalization as appropriate, plus notarized translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) as defined under Circular No. 35/2024/TT-NHNN and the Law on Prevention and Combating Money Laundering; mandatory screening against United Nations Security Council sanctions lists, Viet Nam’s national sanctions and terrorism financing list administered by the State Bank of Viet Nam, United States OFAC SDN List, Japan, Korea, EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists; risk-based customer due diligence and beneficial ownership identification at 10% threshold; mandatory transaction monitoring and suspicious transaction reporting to the Anti-Money Laundering Information Center (AMLIC) under State Bank of Viet Nam; CDD refresh at 6/12-month intervals for high-risk and PEP relationships; prohibition on anonymous accounts and shell-bank relationships; record-keeping for 5 years minimum.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.country_risk_rating_designation: FATF member; residual AML/CFT strategic deficiencies addressed; enhanced scrutiny for transactions involving cash-intensive real estate, precious metals, and cross-border trade remediation fee collections; ongoing monitoring under APG mutual evaluation follow-up.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Registration Information System (Dich vu đăng ký doanh nghiệp qua mạng điện tử) at https://dichvudangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn operated by the Business Registration Management Agency under the Ministry of Planning and Investment (MPI) and at provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) portals
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A foreign-invested limited liability company must register a Vietnamese company name with Latin-script letters, including Vietnamese diacritics, or possibly a simplified Latin transliteration; names must be set in Vietnamese language format in the enterprise registration database; the official name must contain the legal entity form suffix 'Công ty TNHH'; names must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered enterprise; numerals and symbols are allowed only for clarity under Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP Articles 37–41; branch or trade names in foreign languages are permitted only as secondary names; every notice and invoice must show the Vietnamese name; no Cyrillic, Chinese-character, or non-Latin script may be used as the primary registered name; where an English trade name is desired, it is registered as a secondary abbreviated name, but the Vietnamese statutory name and 'Công ty TNHH' suffix control.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: National sovereignty and state agency names
Names identical or confusingly similar to another registered enterprise in Viet Nam
Names identical or confusingly similar to an enterprise dissolved less than 5 years prior, except for companies in bankruptcy restructuring under Article 40 Decree 01/2021/ND-CP
Words referring to the State or Government authorities without special permission, e.g. 'Bộ Công Thương', 'Chính phủ', 'Nhà nước'

Terms requiring prior ministerial license: 'Ngân hàng' (bank), 'Bảo hiểm' (insurance), 'Chứng khoán' (securities), 'Quỹ tín dụng' (credit fund), 'sàn giao dịch' (exchange), 'kiểm toán' (audit), 'luật sư' (lawyer/law firm) unless licensed accordingly
Offensive, discriminatory, or contrary to social ethics terms
Names that misrepresent a profession requiring a practicing certificate, e.g. 'luật' (law), 'kế toán' (accounting) without the relevant practicing license
Military term 'quân đội' and police term 'công an' absent ministerial approval
Political organization names or party symbols
Misleading terms such as 'Tổng công ty' (general corporation) for a single-member LLC not meeting statutory capital/equity thresholds to avoid confusion with state-owned enterprises
Acronyms resembling international organizations (e.g. UN, IMF, WTO) without authorization
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the proposed name is rejected, the applicant submits a revised enterprise name through the online National Enterprise Registration Information System or at the provincial Department of Planning and Investment; the administrative appeal must be filed within 30 days from receipt of the rejection notice under Law No. 59/2020/QH14 Article 32 and administrative procedure law (Law No. 24/2011/QH13 on Complaints and Denunciation), requesting reconsideration by the Director of the provincial DPI; if the DPI maintains rejection, the applicant may lodge a second-level appeal to the Ministry of Planning and Investment within 30 days, or file an administrative lawsuit in the provincial Administrative Court under the Law on Administrative Procedures No. 93/2015/QH13; name reservation is done through pre-application screening and official incorporation application; the system automatically blocks identical names and flags similar names; a written appeal plus evidence of clearance and scrutiny by the Trade Remedies Authority for 'anti-dumping defense consulting' should be attached because use of the trade remedy licensing term is sensitive.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.appeal_filing_mode: Hardcopy written appeal at provincial DPI plus online supplemental via national portal; legal representative or authorized attorney; administrative fees minimal but legal drafting recommendation required.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible for low-risk consulting activities: Viet Nam requires a physical registered address in Viet Nam evidenced by a lease or ownership document; a pure virtual office with no physical presence is not acceptable for foreign-invested company registration; co-working spaces and serviced offices with a dedicated office agreement, letter of confirmation from the landlord, and legal documentation are accepted by provincial DPIs; for the anti-dumping trade defense consulting industry, the DPI and licensing authority (Trade Remedies Authority under MOIT) may require a verifiable place of business with file cabinets, meeting capacity, and presence of legal staff; mailbox-only virtual office is non-compliant under Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP Article 27.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate: the Ministry of Planning and Investment and provincial DPI conduct post-incorporation verification and may inspect the registered address for the first 12 months; the Department of Tax and General Department of Taxation may coordinate unannounced on-site checks for tax registration and license compliance; estimated probability of unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first operating year is 25–35%, rising to 45% for consulting companies invoicing cross-border anti-dumping defense fees because the Trade Remedies Authority and market surveillance agencies may verify actual professional capacity; after license issuance, periodic inspections under MOIT Decree No. 08/2021/ND-CP on trade remedies (as amended) may occur for registered service providers.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.commercial_substance_profile: Clearly articulable substance through lease of a serviced/virtual-plus office, local Vietnamese staff (at least 1 licensed general director), Trade Remedies Authority scope registration, billing in USD via swift/wire to a Viet Nam corporate bank account, and maintenance of all trade-defense consultant records in Viet Nam.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Foreign notaries, competent foreign authorities, Embassy of Viet Nam / consulate, Vietnamese notary public office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark in the foreign origin country plus Vietnamese notarial tariff under Ministry of Justice Circular No. 250/2016/TT-BTC; typically USD 350–600.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and online Enterprise Registration application through the National Enterprise Registration Information System
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) / national online portal service fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registration fee under Circular No. 02/2019/TT-BTC; fee schedule of VND 100,000 (approx. USD 4) for online registration plus portal service fee; USD 25 includes e-submission support of the local agent.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Provincial enterprise registration certificate issuance fee (LLC with 1–10 members)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Circular No. 02/2019/TT-BTC: VND 50,000 for online issuance and VND 100,000 for hardcopy; USD 28 covers official fee and service handling.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal (cachet) registration and official engraving/notarized specimen card
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: DPI registry record plus private engraving vendor
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Article 43–44 Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP; market bench for metal seal plus registration forwarded via DPI; USD 10–20 typical.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Foreign-invested company feasibility/activity scope confirmation and Trade Remedies Authority licensing fit-for-purpose analysis (ISIC 7490 / trade defense consulting)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Vietnamese law advisory firm in coordination with Ministry of Industry and Trade (Trade Remedies Authority of Viet Nam)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Discretionary market benchmark for pre-incorporation clearance of conditional trade-remedy consulting services under MOIT jurisdiction; hourly or fixed scope fee USD 400–800.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of the Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty), member capital contribution schedules, and internal corporate governance documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a dual-language (Vietnamese/English) LLC charter for a foreign-owned LLC; USD 500–900.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office commercial substance package: serviced office/virtual-plus physical suite with short-term lease contract, landlord confirmation, and physical address documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed serviced office provider or landlord registered with provincial DPI in Ho Chi Minh City or Ha Noi
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for one-year serviced office address/administrative support; USD 600–1,200 depending on district and meeting facilities; this stage may include first three-month deposit.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN, and domestic sanctions screening subscription/database usage and compliance report for UBOs and proposed legal representative
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance database vendor / local AML compliance firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark per corporate screening bundle; USD 80–200; conducted under Circular No. 35/2024/TT-NHNN CDD standard.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarized power of attorney and incorporation application signing arrangements in Viet Nam (including consular legalization if any foreign-signed POA), plus courier/translation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Fee for the online document storage, dossier legalization review, and file opening by the incorporator agent

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial DPI / Ministry of Planning and Investment appeal proceedings; legal representation fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for administrative appeal drafting and representation; USD 300–1,200.

stage_1.conditional_licensing_and_trade_remedy_n: Because the business scope ISIC_7490_06_ANTI_DUMPING_TRADE_DEFENSE involves engaging in trade-remedy defense consulting in Viet Nam, the company must apply to the Ministry of Industry and Trade (Trade Remedies Authority of Viet Nam) for registration or licensing as a trade-remedy service provider, and the proposed General Director must hold recognized professional credentials (e.g., licensed lawyer under the Law on Lawyers No. 20/2012/QH13, or licensed customs broker/consultant), must maintain an office in Viet Nam, and must comply with Decree No. 08/2021/ND-CP on trade remedies and the Law on Foreign Trade Management No. 05/2017/QH13. This pre-incorporation due diligence stage incorporates that requirement into name clearance and substance planning.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14, effective 1 January 2021 — Chapter III on Limited Liability Companies, Article 47 on capital contribution and payment schedule, Articles 66-93 on governance of multi-member LLCs and Article 73-75 on single-member LLCs; Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 25-26 on investment registration procedures, Articles 28-29 on market access conditions; Decree 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration — Articles 27-28 (dossier and issuance deadline), Article 33 (publication of registration content), Articles 38-45 (post-registration formalities); Decree 31/2021/ND-CP on Conditional Investment Sectors — Annex IV (line of business not listed as conditional for trade-remedy defense consulting).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office of the provincial-level Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province or centrally-run city where the LLC's registered head office is located, operating through the National Business Registration Portal (https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) administered by the Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp) filed electronically via the National Business Registration Portal, together with the Company Charter, list of members, and constitutive documents required by Article 27 of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an LLC engaged in ISIC 7490 trade-remedy defense consulting, as the sector is not a conditional investment sector under Decree 31/2021/ND-CP Annex IV and carries no legal capital requirement under the Law on Enterprises 2020 or sectoral regulations. The members must pay the subscribed charter capital in full within 90 days from the date the Enterprise Registration Certificate is issued, in accordance with Article 47 of Law on Enterprises 2020. No escrow account, regulatory-capital deposit, or bank-blocked account is mandated for this non-financial, non-brokerage consulting activity. If the company later expands into licensed law-practice services, the capital and licensing conditions of the Law on Lawyers 2006 and Decree 123/2013/ND-CP may apply.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION OF THE MEMBERS' COUNCIL (FIRST CORPORATE RESOLUTION) OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY, VIET NAM. — ADOPTED BY UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT ON [DATE] AT THE REGISTERED OFFICE. 1. CHARTER ADOPTION: The Members resolve to adopt the Company Charter in the form attached to this Resolution, and instruct the Legal Representative to register the Charter with the Department of Planning and Investment. 2. CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION AND CONTRIBUTION: The Members confirm their respective subscriptions to the charter capital set out in the attached Contribution Schedule; each Member undertakes to pay the subscribed portion in full no later than 90 days from the date of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, by wire transfer or lawful means of payment into the corporate account to be opened by the General Director. The Legal Representative is authorized to open such account and to issue capital receipt documentation in compliance with Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises 2020. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION: The registered office of the Company is fixed at [full address, street, ward/district, province], Viet Nam. The office lease/ownership document has been reviewed and the office satisfies the condition of being a lawful, address-validated business premises. 4. APPOINTMENT OF OFFICERS: The Members appoint (i) [Full Name, passport number] as Chairman of the Members' Council and Legal Representative of the Company, and (ii) [Full Name, passport number] as General Director/Chief Executive Officer. The Legal Representative shall have the right to sign and file the Application for Enterprise Registration, the Company Charter, the Investment Registration dossier (if the law so requires), banking mandates, and all ancillary documents with the competent authorities. 5. SEAL AND SIGNING AUTHORITY: The Company shall adopt a corporate seal; the Legal Representative's signature alone binds the Company to third parties with respect to corporate acts within the registered business scope, subject to internal authorization limits. 6. EFFECTIVE DATE AND QUORUM: This Resolution is passed by unanimous consent of 100% of the founding Members constituting the Members' Council, satisfies all quorum requirements of the Law on Enterprises 2020, and is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation, notarization, and legalization of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Notary Office (Phòng Công chứng) or licensed Notary Office (Văn phòng công chứng) in the province of the intended registered office; for foreign-signed documents, the Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate in the shareholder's country or the relevant consular/legalization authority.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Company Charter and the List of Founding Members in Vietnamese; ensure the registered office address, business line ISIC 7490 (Trade-remedy defense consulting), and capital contribution schedule are clearly stated. Each founding member must sign the Charter and Contribution Schedule; if any member signs outside Viet Nam, the signature must be legalized/notarized under Vietnamese consular practice, translated into Vietnamese by a licensed translation service, and certified by a notary. Execute or notarize the office lease agreement or obtain a notarized landlord commitment permitting use of the address for enterprise registration. Take custody of original confirmediary documents for presentation to the DPI upon request.
required_dossiers: Notarized Company Charter (Điều lệ công ty) prepared in Vietnamese
List of founding members and intended charter capital contributions
Notarized/legalized passport copies of all individual members and authorized representatives
Legal entity documents of corporate shareholders (certificate of incorporation, resolution of shareholder approval, power of attorney) if any member is a legal entity
Office lease agreement or notarized commitment from the lessor permitting company registration at the address
Vietnamese translation and certification of all foreign-language documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or consular officer queries signature authenticity or document formalities, correct the signatures, re-execute the documents, or re-obtain legalization; resubmit within the same working day. If translation certification is deficient, engage a licensed translation agency and execute a supplementary certification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Conditional-sector gate review and determination of investment registration certificate (IRC) requirement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal; provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI); Ministry of Planning and Investment (MoPI) for interpretive guidance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify ISIC 7490 'Legal Accounting Defense for International Anti-Dumping Inquiries' against Annex IV of Decree 31/2021/ND-CP and the market-access restrictions listed under Law on Investment 2020, Article 28-29 and Vietnam's WTO services schedule. Because the activity is a professional advisory/consulting service that is not enumerated as a conditional sector, no Investment Registration Certificate is required; foreign investors holding unlimited or company-member ownership may proceed directly to enterprise registration. Prepare a dated legal memorandum recording this gate-check result and retain it in the corporate file. If later any authority classifies the activity as conditional, an IRC must be obtained prior to ERC issuance.
required_dossiers: Legal opinion memorandum concluding that trade-remedy defense consulting is not a conditional AIO sector under Decree 31/2021/ND-CP Annex IV
Draft ERC application prepared for filing
Mapping of the proposed business scope to ISIC 7490 / NAICS 541199
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a request for additional documents or asserts that an IRC is required, file a formal objection supported by Decree 31/2021 Annex IV and the Law on Investment 2020, or submit the investment registration dossier on Form IICA/Form DICA to the DPI to obtain an IRC within 15 working days; appeal any adverse determination to the provincial People's Committee within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the Application for Enterprise Registration and issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province/city of the registered office, via the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the National Business Registration Portal using the legal representative's electronic identification; complete the electronic Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp); attach the Company Charter, List of Founding Members, notarized personal ID documents, legal representative appointment decision, office-location certificate, and all supporting documents. Submit the dossier and pay the state fee electronically if required. The DPI must issue or reject the Enterprise Registration Certificate within 3 working days. Upon approval, download the digital ERC; the certificate contains the enterprise code, business lines, and registered capital information.
required_dossiers: Electronic Application for Enterprise Registration
Company Charter approved by the Members' Council
List of founding members and capital contributions with signatures
Certified/notarized copies of personal identification (passport or ID card) of legal representatives and all members
Notarized office lease agreement or title certificate of the registered office
Decision(s) appointing the Chairman of the Members' Council and Legal Representative
Power of attorney to the filing person if the legal representative does not file directly
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a request for correction (thông báo sửa đổi, bổ sung), the applicant has 10 working days to rectify and resubmit; failure to do so results in dossier cancellation. If the application is refused, request a written refusal stating legal grounds, appeal to the provincial People's Committee under the Law on Complaints 2011 within 30 days, or initiate administrative proceedings in the people's court; alternatively, correct the defects and file a fresh application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory publication of registration content on the National Business Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal (NBRP), Agency for Business Registration, Ministry of Planning and Investment.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the ERC is granted, the DPI automatically transmits the registration content to the NBRP for publication. The company's registration content, including name, enterprise code, head-office address, legal representative, business lines, and charter capital, is published on the portal. The company must pay the publication fee as required; the statutory publication constitutes notice to third parties and is a prerequisite for certain post-registration formalities. Verify the published content is consistent with the ERC.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate number and enterprise code
Confirmation of publication fee payment
Draft publication text in Vietnamese, if manual publication is required in any exceptional case
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the publication is delayed or erroneous, file a correction request with the DPI; if the portal fails to update within 3 working days, request the DPI to issue a manual confirmation of publication. If publication is wrongly refused, appeal the DPI decision to the provincial People's Committee within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration corporate formalities: corporate seal, bank account, and tax registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: District Tax Sub-Department (Chi cục Thuế) as applicable; licensed commercial banks authorized to operate in Viet Nam; the National Business Registration Portal for seal registration notice; the Ministry of Public Security's public administration center where seal registration is performed.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the ERC and enterprise code, obtain a corporate seal in the legal format; under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP the company may design and use its seal, and it must notify the seal's specimen through the National Business Registration Portal or the seal registration authority. Open a corporate bank account at a licensed commercial bank; the bank will perform KYC/AML verification of UBOs and beneficial owners. Deposit charter capital contributions into the corporate account within 90 days, or commit to capital contribution according to the contribution schedule. Register the tax code automatically with receiving the ERC; register the electronic invoice system and accounting period at the district tax office; file a tax registration dossier if the tax code is not automatically integrated. File the labor force registration with the provincial social-insurance agency and the employment service center.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate of the LLC
Company Charter signed by all members
Notarized ID/passport copies of all members and officers
Corporate seal specimen and seal registration notice
Bank account opening application and UBO/AML declaration
Tax registration confirmation and electronic invoice registration form
Labour and social-insurance registration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a bank rejects the account opening due to incomplete KYC, provide additional corporate ownership information and updated UBO statements; if tax registration is not automatically completed, file the supplementary tax registration form with the district tax office and request written confirmation; seal registration defects can be cured by refiling the seal specimen through the NBRP within 2 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Occupational safety, fire-safety, and environmental clearance for the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department (Cảnh sát Phòng cháy chữa cháy) of the local Public Security; the provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) for environmental registration; the provincial Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs for occupational hygiene registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For a consultancy office, the facility is generally a Category A service establishment requiring, at minimum, an environmental registration and a fire-safety self-assessment or, in the case of leased floor space within a certified high-rise building, reliance on the building's master fire-safety acceptance certificate. Submit a fire-safety dossier to the fire police if the office operates independent fire-detection, evacuation routes, and accommodation; obtain the fire-safety acceptance certification (Giấy chứng nhận thẩm duyệt thiết kế về PCCC) as applicable. File an environmental registration with the local DONRE covering office-generated domestic wastewater and solid waste; where applicable, register a workplace hygiene declaration and conduct mandatory occupational health examinations for employees. Ensure compliance with national technical regulations on wastewater and emissions.
required_dossiers: Fire-safety design appraisal dossier and building floor plan
Evidence of the building's master fire-safety acceptance certificate (if leased space)
Environmental registration declaration (Phiếu đăng ký môi trường) and maps/site plan
Wastewater storage/collection arrangement and agreement with municipal sanitation service
Labor hygiene/occupational health examination contract with an approved medical unit
Notice of occupational safety policies and first-aid equipment inventory
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the fire-safety authority objects to design details, remediate the identified issues and resubmit; if the DONRE requests additional environmental documentation, supplement the environmental registration file and obtain the written registration confirmation. Appeals of refusal or late action may be lodged with the provincial People's Committee within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Contingent professional licensing gate for litigation-type trade-defense legal representation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Justice (Sở Tư pháp) and the provincial Bar Association under the Law on Lawyers 2006 and Decree 123/2013/ND-CP.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If the LLC intends to appear before Vietnamese courts as legal counsel in trade-defense or anti-dumping litigation, such activity constitutes law practice and requires the LLC to be licensed as a law-practicing organization and its practitioner to hold a lawyer's license. The LLC must either (i) maintain its entity as a commercial advisory firm limited to non-litigation defense strategies, regulatory submissions, and economic analysis, or (ii) restructure into a law-practicing LLC authorized by the Department of Justice. This step is triggered only when the business scope includes 'representation in Vietnamese judicial procedures'.
required_dossiers: Decision of the Members' Council limiting or including litigation activities
Lawyer's practicing certificate of the individual responsible for litigation
License-to-practice application for a law-practicing organization, including charter amendments and disciplinary records
Certificate of professional indemnity insurance, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Department of Justice refuses licensing, withdraw the contested litigation scope and revise the charter to limit the business to advisory trade-defense consultation; the company may appeal the refusal to the Ministry of Justice within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: For non-manufacturing trade-remedy defense consulting in ISIC 7490, no industrial manufacturing license is issued by an industrial licensing board. The general operating authority is the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) under the Law on Enterprises 2020. For the substantive trade-defense affairs, the competent policy authority is the Trade Remedies Authority of Viet Nam (Cục Phòng vệ thương mại), Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT), which receives and administers anti-dumping and anti-subsidy disputes; that authority does not license the consulting firm itself. If the firm expands to courtroom legal representation, the competent licensing authority is the provincial Department of Justice under the Law on Lawyers 2006.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Enterprise Registration Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký doanh nghiệp) issued by the provincial DPI, specifically authorizing the legal-capacity and business line 'Legal Accounting Defense for International Anti-Dumping Inquiries' (ISIC 7490). No additional industrial operation license applies to pure advisory activity; however, if litigious legal practice is included, the firm must additionally hold a License for Establishment of a Law-Practicing Organization (Giấy đăng ký hoạt động của tổ chức hành nghề luật sư) under Decree 123/2013/ND-CP.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE, Bộ Tài nguyên và Môi trường) at the central level and the provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE, Sở Tài nguyên và Môi trường) at the implementing level.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Environmental Registration (not Full EIA Report) — Category: Small-scale service office. The project is not listed in Annex II of Decree 08/2022/ND-CP and hence is not subject to a full Environmental Impact Assessment. Because the office generates only domestic wastewater, municipal solid waste, and negligible air pollution, it is subject to a simplified environmental registration procedure (đăng ký môi trường) before commencement of operation; in certain provinces, when the office is attached to central water supply/sewerage systems and has no hazardous waste, the registration may be waived if the lessor's system tolerance has been certified.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic wastewater after treatment must meet QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT — National Technical Regulation on Domestic Wastewater (BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L; TSS ≤ 50 mg/L; total coliforms ≤ 3,000 MPN/100 mL; pH 5-9). If a standby diesel generator is installed, exhaust gases must comply with QCVN 19:2009/BTNMT — National Technical Regulation on Industrial Emissions for Dust and Inorganic Substances (particulate matter ≤ 200 mg/Nm3; SO2 ≤ 500 mg/Nm3; NOx ≤ 850 mg/Nm3; CO ≤ 1,000 mg/Nm3). Hazardous waste generated by the office, including spent toners and fluorescent lamps, must be identified, stored in labelled containers, and transferred to an authorized hazardous-waste treatment facility in accordance with Decree 08/2022/ND-CP and QCVN 07:2009/BTNMT. Solid waste must be collected by municipal waste services or a licensed waste contractor, with manifests retained for inspection.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety and rescue clearance: (i) If the LLC leases office space inside an existing building that has already received its fire-safety acceptance certificate, the LLC must receive a written acknowledgment from the building owner that the leased area complies with the master fire-safety plan; (ii) if the LLC operates a standalone office, it must obtain the Fire-Safety Design Approval and Post-construction Acceptance Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận thẩm duyệt thiết kế về phòng cháy, chữa cháy and nghiệm thu về PCCC) under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP, including evacuation signage, extinguishers, and emergency lighting. Structural load clearance: for office use of a floor within a completed building, reliance on the building's structural acceptance certificate is accepted; for independent structures, a licensed structural engineer must certify that the floor loads for office occupancy and filing/archive density do not exceed rated load. Occupational clearance: the LLC must register workplace hygiene and occupational safety with the provincial Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs, conduct periodic occupational health examinations for employees under the Law on Occupational Safety and Health No. 84/2015/QH13, and provide workplace first-aid equipment and a written safety regulation set.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT) under the Ministry of Finance of Viet Nam; online portal: thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn (e-Tax Portal) and Dich vu cong quoc gia (National Public Service Portal at dichvucong.gov.vn)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign-invested limited liability companies are required to obtain a Tax Identification Number (MST) via the enterprise registration process at the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI). The DPI issues the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), which simultaneously serves as the tax registration certificate referencing the tax ID. The enterprise must subsequently complete tax code activation and file an initial declaration using the e-Tax portal (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn) through a valid digital signature (USB token or e-Signature) within statutory timelines. A separate VAT registration is not required; the corporate TIN functions as the VAT identification number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: The foreign-invested LLC is a separate tax resident entity subject to Corporate Income Tax (CIT) at the standard rate of 20%. It is also a VAT-registered taxable person subject to output VAT, input VAT crediting, and VAT finalization where applicable. Territorial_Scope: Tax residence in Viet Nam applies to entities incorporated under Vietnamese law with legal seat or place of effective management in Viet Nam; worldwide income (including foreign-source income) is subject to CIT with foreign tax credit relief. Tax_Exempt_Zone: Not automatically applicable; eligibility for preferential tax zones, industrial zones, export processing zones (EPZs), high-tech zones, or economic zones requires separate approval and satisfaction of investment incentive conditions under Decree 218/2013/ND-CP and the Law on Investment 2020.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam generally does not operate a full check-the-box classification regime comparable to the U.S. Treasury Regulations. However, the following statutory elections and mechanisms are available: (i) election of small- and medium-sized enterprise CIT incentives or high-tech/export-processing enterprise incentives based on qualifying investment certificates; (ii) election to apply the foreign tax credit method for foreign-source income under Circular 78/2014/TT-BTC; (iii) election of VAT deduction method versus direct method based on registration and accounting records; (iv) consolidated VAT offsetting in accordance with joint circulars; (v) hybrid mismatch election treatment limited to treaty non-discrimination and double taxation agreement (DTA) relief, including the possible use of the Mutual Agreement Procedure (MAP) under applicable DTAs; and (vi) for cross-border consulting service income, election or reliance on the Permanent Establishment (PE) threshold and profit attribution rules under DTAs and Decree 132/2020/ND-CP on transfer pricing.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng) - Value Added Tax under Law on Value Added Tax No. 13/2008/QH12 as amended by Law No. 31/2013/QH13 and Law No. 106/2016/QH13 and implementing Decree 209/2013/ND-CP and Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no general registration threshold in local legal currency (VND) for enterprises; all companies incorporated and operating in Viet Nam are subject to VAT registration and must obtain a VAT identification number regardless of turnover, except that foreign contractors and foreign organizations without a Vietnamese establishment may be subject to Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) withholding VAT in lieu of full registration. For household businesses and individuals, the VAT registration and declaration threshold is annual turnover exceeding 100 million VND. For a foreign-invested LLC engaged in consulting services, the de minimis threshold effectively does not apply; registration is mandatory.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Viet Nam has implemented a mandatory e-invoicing (Hóa đơn điện tử) system under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. All VAT-registered enterprises must use data-standardized electronic invoices generated via certified e-invoice service providers or the GDT's e-invoice portal; each invoice must be digitally signed using the enterprise's registered digital certificate and transmitted to the e-invoice system for data validation and registration. For sales to tax authorities, state agencies, and in certain high-risk scenarios, invoice-by-invoice real-time transmission to the GDT is required; otherwise, periodic batch transmission is permitted under current regulations. The GDT is progressively implementing the national e-invoice data integration system (Hệ thống hóa đơn điện tử) with application programming interface (API) connections from business accounting systems to the GDT's central portal, and is expanding real-time invoice clearance and digital stamping for verifiable invoices linked to customs, banking, and corporate tax records.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies to exported goods and services, including export-processed goods, offshore services provided to foreign organizations/individuals for consumption outside Viet Nam, goods sold to export processing enterprises (EPEs), and services supplied to foreign parties for use outside Viet Nam, provided that (i) the transaction qualifies as an export under customs or service export regulations; (ii) the enterprise holds full documentation proving the goods were physically exported or the service was actually rendered offshore; (iii) payment is received in convertible foreign currency from abroad or from an EPE; and (iv) the enterprise has a real economic transaction and sufficient supporting contracts. Consulting services for international anti-dumping trade defense provided to foreign clients are zero-rated only if the services are consumed outside Viet Nam and documentary evidence of offshore consumption and foreign-currency payment is preserved.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Viet Nam Customs Export Declaration (Tờ khai hải quan hàng hóa xuất khẩu) duly electronically filed through the VNACCS/VCIS national single window
Original or certified true copy of commercial invoice
Original or certified true copy of Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill (AWB) evidencing international carriage
Packing list and any other customs-required shipping documents
Export contract or purchase order with foreign buyer
Foreign remittance/telegraphic transfer advice evidencing actual receipt of foreign currency payment in convertible currency
Bank Foreign Exchange Inward Remittance Certificate or Bank Export Confirmation/Certificate of Foreign Currency Receipt issued by the authorized bank

Service export supporting contract, Foreign Contractor Tax withholding certificate (if applicable), proof of offshore consumption, and any non-processing attestation issued by Vietnamese authorities for services supplied to offshore clients
VAT zero-rating declaration and e-invoice bearing 0% VAT code where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Claims for zero-rated export VAT are subject to stringent GDT and customs audit scrutiny, especially for service exports. The General Department of Taxation may require supplementary documentation proving actual offshore consumption, bank statements evidencing foreign-currency inflow, and the commercial substance of the recipient. Any failure to substantiate zero-rating within the statutory deadlines results in retrospective VAT assessment, accrual of late-payment interest computed at 0.03%/day on the under-assessed VAT, and administrative fines of up to 20 times the amount of the tax evasion under the Law on Tax Administration 2019 (in severe cases, criminal sanctions under the Penal Code 2015, including fines up to VND 4.5 billion and imprisonment up to 20 years). Additional penalties apply for incorrect e-invoice issuance, including suspension of e-invoice usage, fines between VND 4 million and VND 20 million per invoice, and disqualification from VAT refunds for periods under audit. Export VAT refunds are subject to pre-refund audit (pre-assessment) for high-risk taxpayers, and clawbacks of refunded amounts are levied together with penal interest and administrative sanctions if false documentation is discovered.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The State Bank of Vietnam (SBV / Ngan Hang Nha Nuoc Viet Nam), acting as the central bank and the sole competent authority for foreign exchange administration, together with the Ministry of Finance for tax-linked remittance and foreign trade remedies coordination. The SBV issues the daily VND/USD reference rate, manages the managed-floating exchange rate band, and licenses authorized banks for FX trading and cross-border payment clearing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Viet Nam maintains de jure current-account convertibility for service exports and profit remittances, but de facto convertibility is subject to documentary compliance by the licensed bank. Capital-account transactions, including shareholder equity injections, inbound loans, and cross-border guarantees, require mandatory registration with the SBV through a licensed bank (e.g., Direct Investment Capital Account – DICA regime). Profit remittance is permitted once the LLC satisfies annual CIT finalization, has audited financial statements, distributable after-tax profits approved by the Members' Council, and presents a tax clearance/confirmation from the tax authority. Dividend repatriation also requires the bank to receive the appropriate purpose code and a certification that no outstanding tax obligations exist. The VND is not fully convertible offshore; all profit and capital repatriation must be settled through an onshore licensed bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange No. 28/2005/PL-UBTVQH11 (as amended) and SBV operational guidelines, export receipts, including service-export fees for anti-dumping trade-defense consulting, must be repatriated to the LLC's foreign-currency account at a licensed Vietnamese bank within 90 days from the date of customs clearance for goods or from the contractual payment-due date for services; an extension of up to 180 days in aggregate may be approved by the SBV on a case-by-case hardship basis. The mandatory conversion (surrender) ratio for export proceeds is 0% – no forced sale to the SBV or authorized bank is required. The LLC may hold export proceeds in a foreign-currency account indefinitely, or sell them to licensed banks at negotiated rates, and must ensure that the export service invoices and contracts clearly evidence the foreign-source payment to avoid reclassification as capital inflows.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (VND & USD current/EFC) and Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) for equity injection

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (VND & USD current/EFC) and DICA

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (VND & USD current/EFC) and DICA

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank (Techcombank)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-moderate viability for treasury operations but strictly supplementary to a licensed onshore bank account. Offshore digital EMIs (multi-currency payment platforms domiciled in Singapore, the UK, or the EU) cannot hold VND, do not have access to the Vietnamese interbank payment system, and cannot clear statutory DICA obligations, CIT payments, or employee payroll. They may be used as collection wallets for inbound retainer fees from international clients and as payment conduits for overseas expert-witness or expert-report disbursements, but all funds must ultimately be swept to the LLC's onshore account to meet repatriation and audit trail requirements. The SBV only licenses domestic fintech payment intermediaries acting as agents of licensed banks; an offshore EMI holding or processing VND executes no legally valid Vietnamese FX transaction. Therefore, classify offshore EMI viability as 'Low' for primary treasury, 'Medium' as an ancillary cross-border receivable accelerator with strict reconciliation controls.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of the legal representative or an authorised signatory is mandatory for the initial corporate account opening in the majority of Vietnamese banks. The director or a senior officer appointed by a notarised power of attorney (with consular legalisation or apostille plus Vietnamese translation) must appear in person at the chosen branch for the original due-diligence interview, original document inspection, and e-banking token issuance. Video KYC is generally not accepted as a substitute for the first corporate onboarding; some tier-1 banks permit a hybrid remote interview only after the authorised representative has previously held a personal account at the same bank. The defence dossier must be physically presented in original or notarised-certified-copy form, and the bank will independently verify the LLC's Enterprise Registration Certificate, Investment Registration Certificate, and SBV e-portal status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound wire payments with vague references such as 'defence fund', 'retainer', 'consultancy fee' that may be misconstrued as opaque third-party funding or trade-remittance unrelated collection.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Every material inbound transfer must be paired with: (i) the signed service agreement and its payment schedule; (ii) the original VAT-eligible invoice issued by the LLC as a Vietnamese service exporter; (iii) the client's purchase order or instruction letter confirming the retainer reference; (iv) substantive evidence of services delivered, including substantive filings to the investigating authority (case docket numbers), expert economic reports, legal memoranda, or hearing transcripts; (v) a completed bank-issued 'Know Your Client's Client' form for any payment exceeding USD 50,000; (vi) the LLC's reconciliation spreadsheet mapping the SWIFT reference to the receivable ledger; (vii) confirmation from the client's bank that funds derive from the client's own operating account, thereby avoiding third-party-payment suspicion. The LLC should also prepare an annual internal audit trial of all trade-defense engagements to evidence that profit margin is arm's-length and non-circular.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injections from foreign investors must be routed only through SWIFT MT103/MT202 instructions to the LLC's DICA at a licensed Vietnamese bank, with the wire message containing the SBV-approved purpose code corresponding to 'contribution of charter capital to an FDI enterprise' and explicit referencing of the IRC number, the investing entity's name, and the capital-to-be-contributed. The receiving bank will verify that the remitter is identical to the shareholder listed in the company's IRC and the Vietnamese enterprise registration, and will require a payment-credit confirmation or a subsequent capital-contribution certificate to be submitted within the statutory window. Inbound loans from foreign shareholders (except exempt short-term loans of less than one year with no accrued interest) must undergo mandatory SBV registration via the Direct Lending Facility from authorized banks by the borrower before drawdown, with the purpose code 'FF – foreign loan proceeds'. After crediting, the LLC must report on the SBV's periodic FDI information system (system for statistics) and ensure that no mixture of operating cashflows with capital-account ledger entries occurs.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Consultancy fee disbursements to overseas experts, co-counsel, economic consultants, and translation agencies are made via SWIFT MT103 (customer credit transfer) referencing the appropriate service-payment purpose code (e.g., 'payment for imported services') and supported by a copy of the relevant service contract, VAT invoice assessment, and withholding tax status. Where a foreign client or partner insists on documentary credit, a Commercial Letter of Credit (MT700) may be issued by the LLC's bank with the beneficiary presenting a benign set of documents (invoice, delivery certificate of legal services, expert report acceptance) under UCP600. Profit distribution to the foreign shareholder must be a clearing transfer from the operational account after CIT finalization, using purpose code 'dividend remittance to foreign investor' and attachment of the audited financial statements, Members' Council meeting minutes, and tax clearance confirmation. The LLC should maintain a segregated USD-denominated account for FX receipts and a VND current account for domestic tax and payroll clearing to avoid mixing.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable onshore foreign-exchange forwards (USD/VND and international crosses such as EUR/USD, USD/JPY) transacted bilaterally with a licensed Vietnamese bank, maximum tenor normally up to 365 days, permitted only where the LLC has genuine underlying commercial exposures from trade-defense service receivables or payables (no speculative forward positions).

Onshore foreign-exchange options (OTC calls and puts on USD/VND, EUR/USD) bought from licensed banks to hedge asymmetric retainer-fee inflows and foreign-expert fee obligations, with premium settled in VND or convertible currency.

Cross-currency swaps and FX swaps executed with licensed commercial banks against underlying offshore loan facilities (registered with the SBV) to synthetically hedge both principal and interest cashflows; non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not authorised instruments for onshore corporate treasury operations under Vietnamese regulations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động của doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days from the end of the fiscal year; if calendar fiscal year, due by 31 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP of VND 5,000,000–20,000,000; late filing may also lead to forced submission and punitive measures on enterprise tax identification status

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual License Tax Declaration and Payment (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Sub-Department of General Department of Taxation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payment and declaration due by 30 January of each year for active enterprises; newly established entities must pay within 10 days after license issuance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest 0.03%/day on overdue amount; administrative fine up to 3% of the declared annual license tax; prolonged non-payment may lead to enforced collection and enterprise suspension

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation via national online tax portal (iTax)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the end of the fiscal year; for calendar fiscal year, due by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fine of VND 4,800,000–12,000,000 under Tax Administration Law; late payment interest 0.03%/day; deliberate understatement triggers additional penalty equal to 20% of underpaid amount

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Submission of Audited Financial Statements (if compulsory audit applies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment, General Department of Taxation, and State Audit of Vietnam (if applicable)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audit must be completed within 90 days of fiscal year-end; audited statements submitted to DPI and tax authority within 30 days of the auditor's opinion date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine under Decree 50/2016/ND-CP for failure to submit audited financial statements; administrative penalty up to VND 20,000,000 per omission; may affect annual enterprise report approval and export/trading privileges

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all foreign-invested enterprises in Vietnam, all public companies, financial/credit/insurance/investment fund managers, and medium or large enterprises meeting thresholds in Decree 174/2016/ND-CP; for an LLC with foreign investment, audit is compulsory regardless of annual revenue or asset size
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) issued by the Ministry of Finance; wholly foreign-invested enterprises with parent adopting IFRS may use IFRS-based reporting if permitted by Vietnam's Ministry of Finance under Circular 178/2012/TT-BTC; statutory financial statements must be prepared in VND and Vietnamese language.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not operate a public UBO register; the LLC files an annual enterprise report confirming the direct shareholding structure as at year-end. Any change in members, shares, or indirect ownership of 1% or more must be notified to the DPI within 10 days under Law on Enterprises 2020; no standalone annual UBO confirmation filing exists.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Pledged Shares and Capital Contributions

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard 20% statutory CIT rate applies to limited liability companies. Preferential rates of 10%, 15%, and 17% and tax holidays of two to four years are available only for qualifying new investment projects in encouraged sectors or designated regions; professional trade-remedy defense consulting (ISIC 7490) does not automatically qualify. A temporary 15% rate applied to small- and medium-sized taxpayers with annual total revenue not exceeding VND 20 billion during the statutory support window. Absent a specific incentive certificate, all income is taxed at 20%.
